scene sky
scene skyyy
There’s a pep in my step as I step up the steps. And in other news, the sky is blue. Just this time there’s a smile too.
The smile is red, my girlfriend is dead, and for lack of more rhyming, GET OUT OF MY HEAD.
scene sky
Sorry.
Now, where was I?
Oh, right. Walking.
Right now, I’m on my way home from the store — a place I’ve been regularly visiting lately on account of my niece being broken.
It was obnoxious at first, but I’ve come to somewhat appreciate these minor breaks in which I can pretend I’m a normal person doing normal things, buying normal products for his normal family.
But of course, the situation is anything but. And while I’ll tell myself the opposite to keep this half-smile plastered to my plaster face, each glance down reminds me that’s anything but true.
Because, you see, there’s something unfortunate inside this bag — one more symbol of my inadequacy and the ultimate mark that I’m a failure as a guardian.
Girls don’t work the same as boys do.
Things happen to them that don’t happen to us.
Unfortunate things. Terrible things. And it’s easy for someone like me to forget what’s required in preparation for things like that when I’ve never had to do anything about them before.
But given that Ami can barely get out of bed as she is now...
Do you see where I’m going with this?
Yes, the task itself is simple. And not even remotely as abnormal or depressing as I made it sound with the opening words of this anecdote.
But it’s such a simple, baseline reminder of how absent I have been and how pathetic I am as a guardian to not think of this until asked.
I have never been present for anyone but myself. That’s what I keep thinking with each and every step up the steps.
So yes, the sky is blue. Yes, my girlfriend is dead. But there is no pep at all.
Just a confused man fumbling his way through parenthood for the first time in his life while his makeshift daughter cries of embarrassment in the bathroom.
scene black
I am a failure.
All I’ve done is feed her.
scene nikishome1
As I step into my home and place the bag down on the kitchen counter to avoid drawing attention to its contents, I recall a poem I used to love. But it’s strange that such a thing is possible now.
The contents of my past have been slowly bleeding back into me thanks to a metaphorical IV plugged into my arm by some girl with pink hair.
And while it gets caught on things when I roll over too quickly — while the plastic skin-shovel holding it in place pinches me each time I forget it’s there-
It does its job well.
She does her job well.
scene nikishome2
I just wish she would fucking listen.
scene nikishome3
You’re probably wondering what poem I was talking about a second ago.
It’s called the Clod and the Pebble.
It’s a poem about love.
I won’t burden you with its entirety, you can find it on your own if your curiosity consumes you.
But there are two important lines I will leave you with before severing these thoughts once more.
Stanza one, line one — Love seeketh not Itself to please.
Stanza three, line one — Love seeketh only Self to please.
Note the capitalization.
Do you want to know what I keep in my pocket?
It’s a picture from before this all started.
A girl with twintails in a field full of flowers, backlit by a gorgeous sun nestled in the upper right-hand corner of the frame.
She’s smiling...laughing at something.
I wasn’t there for it, but I wish that I was.
Because now-
I would kill for her.
scene nikishome2
I love my niece.
And it is my job to protect her.
: Oh, you’re home.
scene nikishome4
: I didn’t hear you come in.
: Do you want tea? I just made some.
: This is my house.
: Mhm.
: That’s my mug.
scene nikishome5
: Mhm.
: Niki...what are you doing?
: You weren’t answering the door so I let myself in. Is there a problem with that?
: Yes. There is, actually.
scene nikishome6
: Ooooooh. Are you gonna punish me? Fine. Just make it quick or my tea will get cold.
: I’m being serious, Niki. I told you not to come here. I told you I could handle this on my own.
: Oh, was that the conversation we had right before you boned me into unconsciousness? Cause my memory’s kinda hazy from around that time.
: Yes. Yes it was.
: And you agreed that you wouldn’t try to get involved with Ami.
scene nikishome7
: I don’t know, Akira. That doesn’t sound like me.
: STOP FUCKING AROUND!
scene nikishome8
: This...is my responsibility. It’s something I need to figure out on my own. And that’s what Ami wants as well. It’s not just me.
: Akira...you are not allowed to yell at me like that. That was not okay.
: You’re in my fucking house!
scene nikishome9
: I don’t care if I’m in your fucking room! You don’t yell at me! Especially when I’m just trying to help!
scene nikishome10
: Now, speak to me like a fucking adult or you’re going to wake Ami back up.
: Ami isn’t asleep, she’s-
: Yeah, she is. I just watched her fall asleep, asshole. She texted me asking for help because she didn’t trust you to buy the right fucking tampons.
: But sorry, what were you saying about how Ami wants you to handle this on your own?
: You...
: She...
: Apologize for yelling at me. Now.
: Now.
: I’m sorry...
scene nikishome11
: You’re forgiven. See? That’s how easy it is to solve problems when you’re open to not being a little bitch about them.
: Did she really reach out to you?...
scene nikishome12
: Why do you sound so upset about that?
: Akira, you’re fighting a losing battle here. There’s no way you can handle Ami on your own. That’s why I wanted to help you.
scene nikishome13
: She needs a woman in her life. There’s just...shit you don’t understand yet. And that’s fine because you never learned.
: So if you want to think I’m overstepping some boundaries because you did not invite me into your house, fine...
: But I urge you to think about what she needs if you’re seriously invested in getting her out of this. Not what you need. Because facing this alone will only make her worse.
scene nikishome4
: So, do you want tea or not? Speak now or you’re not getting any.
: Okay then. You’re not getting any.
: Can I have my mug back?
: Depends. Is there one that says “#1 Aunt” on it?
: I...don’t think so.
: Then no. You can have it back when you live up to the title. But for now, I’m going to hang onto it since I’m the one who saved the day, not you.
: Niki-
: Just sit the fuck down and let me make you some god damn tea, asshole.
scene black
Okay...so maybe my internal monologuing got a bit darker than it needed to before.
But can you really blame me?
How was I supposed to know that Ami would reach out to Niki instead of one of her friends?
I’m sure Ayane could have done the same exact thing that-
You know exactly why.
I don’t.
Liar! She wants her mother but her mother’s dead!
scene amiani12
scene amibus1
scene amimakesyoudinner1
scene nikishome14
You know it’s true because YOU want her as well! You’re a hopeless piece of shit without her! You can’t do anything on your own!
You still hear her in the walls! See her reflection in the mirror! And you wish SO BADLY for her to tear down the barrier between life and death to RETURN TO FORM, but she never does!
So you cry and you fail and you fail and you cry and drag other WORTHLESS girls into your own bullshit problems because you can’t solve ANYTHING on your own!
scene nikishome15
scene nikishome14
scene nikishome15
scene nikishome14
I taught you better than this, my lightning-bug.
Should I have nibbled on your ear more? Sliced your scrotum with my nails?
What could I have done to make you better?
: Akira...I’m going to ask you again...but do you want to talk or not?
: Not just about Ami...about everything. Because I know this runs deeper than just her.
: Can we pick just one problem and focus on that instead?
: If that’s easier for you, sure. But without knowing where to begin, I-
: I don’t want to be a parent.
scene nikishome16

: I’m not cut out for it. You know that. Ami knows that. Everyone knows that. And it really fucking sucks because I have to be one now and I’m failing so badly that it’s dragging people like you into it.
: I’m here because I want to be, Akira. Not because I have to be. And besides, I don’t want to be a parent either.
: But, like you said, sometimes you kind of have to be one. Even if it sucks. But that doesn’t mean you can’t figure out a way to make it suck a little less.
: There’s this girl in my class who idolizes you, you know. More than even Ami does.
: Her father left her and her mother died. And she has a little sister with some kind of fucking...auto-immune disease that she’s been taking care of ever since.
: She makes it look so effortless and she’s only half my age. Why can’t I do that?
: And Kaori- you remember her, right? She has a child of sorts too now.
: I’m aware. She fell asleep on my shoulder.
: Then you probably know that Kaori is better at this than I am as well. Kaori. She doesn’t even know what hands are called.
: Why can’t I be like them? Why can’t I do this alone?
: Are you asking me for advice or do you just want me to listen?
: Advice. Please. I have no idea what to do.
scene nikishome17
: Hah...
scene nikishome18
: Ready for me to sound pushy and overbearing?
: Sound however you want if it will get me out of this mess.
: Akira, nothing is ever going to get you out of this mess.

: Even when Ami is old enough to move out...and head off to college or...do whatever it is she wants to do with her life, you’re still going to be her dad. You stopped being an uncle a long fucking time ago, babe.
: And that means you’re always going to worry about her.
: Take my dad for example. Did you know he still calls me after every single concert to ask me how things went?
: Are you just bragging now? This isn’t a situation where I can just ask Ami how she is and have her instantly get better.
: I’m not bragging, asshole. I’m just giving you an example of how the kind of bond you have with Ami is one that’ll never go away no matter what happens.
: She’s all you have and you’re all she has. And that makes that connection even stronger. So there’s no way you can just get out of it and looking at things that way is all wrong.
scene nikishome19
: But...she won’t be heading off to college for at least a few more years. Which means you need to make the most of the time you’ve got left with her.
Tell her! About the rooftop! About the girl with aquamarine eyes!
I will tell her nothing.
Tell her! Tell her, Akira!
She does not deserve this pain.
: And one way I think...to make the most of that time together...
scene nikishome20
: Is to give her a real family again.
: Or at least...something that resembles one.
: Let me move in with you. Let me be her mom.
: Niki-
: I know how it sounds, which is why I gave you that warning about how it was going to be pushy and overbearing. But you’ve gotta admit- it makes a lot of sense, right?
: Like, not only does Ami trust me to do what you can’t, but I don’t even really have a place of my own yet.
: I basically just bounce around between hotels all the time and...crash with my parents when I’m not doing that. Living here would give me a...base of sorts.
: I don’t think Ami would want that, Niki. This is...way bigger than just bringing her emergency feminine hygiene products.
: If she tells me she doesn’t want me here, we can throw out the idea. I’m only suggesting it because A) I care about her. And B) I love you.
: I’m a saint, yes. But even I wouldn’t offer to move in and become a pseudo-parent if both of those things weren’t true.
: As...nice as that sounds...I was hoping for advice that would maybe make things a little easier for me to do this on my own.
scene nikishome21
: Baby, I love you, but no. I can’t let you kill yourself and your niece because you’re too stubborn to accept my help.
: Ami’s going to get sick if you keep this up. Physically sick. Like, what have you even been feeding her?
: Whatever I can find. All I have to do is get her back to normal so she can start cooking for herself again. It’s okay if she doesn’t have a perfectly balanced diet until then.
: But without a timeline on when that will happen, you’re putting the poor girl at risk. And that’s not even touching on what she’s done to her hair.
: I can fix that too, you know. I used to cut yours when we were kids, remember?
: Again, I wish I did...
scene nikishome22
: God, I’ve gotta stop fucking asking if you remember things. It always depresses the fuck out of me when you don’t.
: Niki...even if Ami is okay with you living here, which she won’t be...I don’t think it’s something you want to do.
scene nikishome23
: Why would it not be something I want to do?
: Because not only will you have to see my face first-thing every morning, but it will get in the way of your career.
: I’m a professional, Akira. I think I can manage.
: Sure, you think you can manage. But the second you trip on stage or...forget a line of a song because you’re worrying about what Ami’s eating for dinner, you’ll need to make a choice.
: And that’s not a situation I want to put you in.
: Akira, I’m 29. My years as an idol are numbered as-is. And frankly, it’s a miracle I’ve lasted this long to begin with.
: But still, I can’t do that to you. You’re too...valuable. You’re too good.
: You could list a zillion other positive adjectives to describe me, but none of them change the fact that I’d throw everything away for the life I really want.
: And you’d never guess what it is I see first-thing in the morning in that ideal world, Akira. But, spoiler alert, it’s the same thing I’d see right before going to sleep — you.
: I definitely could have guessed that based on context.
: Yeah, well you didn’t guess it fast enough and you’re a jerk for even questioning my commitment at this point. Let’s talk to her.
: Only if you’re on board, though. Because if you really do think I’m proposing this too soon then, A) I’m sorry. And B) How much fucking longer do you need? Because we’ve known each other forever.
: At the very least, please-
scene nikishome24
: Oh! Hey, Ami. We didn’t wake you up, did we?
scene nikishome25
: Okay. I guess she’s just...using the restroom.
: I’ll ask her.
scene nikishome26
: So...you’re okay with it? With me?...
: Ami deserves a better life...
: But...are you okay with it, Akira? Because I don’t want to do this if you’re only doing it for Ami.
: And, no offense, but you have a hard time making decisions when there’s more than one variable involved.
: Akira?...
scene black
: Which side of the bed do you prefer to sleep on?
$ nikispring2 = True
$ niki_love += 5
Niki’s affection has increased by 5!
You worry how many eggs your nest can hold.
There is no easy way to find out.
Night comes.
